title: Beyond Hallucinations: The Illusion of Understanding in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of human-AI dialogue (specifically the Blake Lemoine and LaMDA case study) using the proposed Rose-Frame framework to trace how fast, intuitive (System 1) thinking and emotional phrasing override analytical reasoning.

Evaluating human-LLM interaction logs to identify epistemic drift, closed loops of false belief, and mutual affirmation, demonstrating how models and users favor agreement and acquiescence over constructive conflict and falsification.
